name: spec_lookup
description: Look up a 3DMigoto/XXMI ini section, key, command, operator, ->member, function or enum: docs, args, XXMI-only flag, example and DLL source location. Members carry a target (resource or shader); commands with form "value" are written as the value, not as a key.

section.description: for keys: the section that reads it

dll_ref.description: DLL version the spec comes from: latest-release (default), latest-prerelease, head, a tag, a commit prefix or bundled

name: spec_list
description: List names with one-line docs of one spec kind, e.g. all keys valid in [Resource*].

dll_ref.description: DLL version the spec comes from: latest-release (default), latest-prerelease, head, a tag, a commit prefix or bundled

name: library_list
description: List the libraries (namespaces) of a game package with symbol counts and module docs.

ref.description: branch, tag or commit; default latest

name: library_symbol
description: Describe a game-package library symbol (e.g. CommandList\ZZMI\SetTextures, $\TTL\alpha): location, doc comments, usage, references, inputs and source.

ref.description: branch, tag or commit; default latest

name: find_implementation
description: Where the XXMI DLL implements an ini feature (store, Pool, ->Region, handling, ...): ranked file:line list with snippets and permalinks.

ref.description: DLL branch, tag or commit; default latest

name: search_source
description: Regex search (ripgrep) in an indexed repo: dll, zzmi or xxmitools. Matches come with 2 lines of context.

ref.description: branch, tag or commit; default latest

name: read_source
description: Read lines of a file in an indexed repo (dll, zzmi or xxmitools), at most 400 lines.

path.description: path inside the repo, e.g. DirectX11/CommandList.cpp

ref.description: branch, tag or commit; default latest

name: lint_ini
description: Lint ini text with the xxmi linter. files maps a path (e.g. Mods/MyMod/mod.ini, decides namespace) to its text. Same diagnostics as `xxmi lint --format json`; library references resolve against the indexed package.

files.description: {path: content}; up to 1 MB and 200 files in total

package_ref.description: package branch, tag or commit; default latest

dll_ref.description: DLL version the spec comes from: latest-release (default), latest-prerelease, head, a tag, a commit prefix or bundled

name: list_versions
description: Indexed repos and refs (default branch, releases, pre-releases), the spec status of each DLL version, the spec used by default, and the DLL commit the bundled spec was extracted from.
